title: System setup and input generation
action: Construct unit cells for the four systems (ISW-NT, BSW-NT, ISW-NT with C vacancy, ISW-NT with Si vacancy) and generate Quantum ESPRESSO input files for structural relaxation. The (7,7) armchair nanotube unit cell contains 28 atoms in the pristine case and 27 atoms for each vacancy-defected case. The bundle uses a tetragonal unit cell with one nanotube per cell. For isolated tubes, set the cross-section (a and b) lattice parameters to 30 Å. Use ultrasoft pseudopotentials for C and Si (4 valence electrons, s²p²), a kinetic energy cutoff of 350 eV, Gaussian smearing of 0.1 eV, k-point grids of 1×1×20 (isolated tubes) and 8×8×8 (bundle).
description: Generate DFT input files for the four SiC nanotube configurations.

title: Structural relaxation and equation-of-state fitting
action: For each of the four systems, perform variable-cell structural relaxation to minimise the total energy with respect to unit-cell volume and internal atomic positions. Compute the total energy at several unit-cell volumes spanning the equilibrium, then fit the energy-versus-volume data to Murnaghan's equation of state. From the fit, extract the equilibrium lattice constants (a, b, c), bulk modulus components (along a, b, c axes), tubular diameter, and radial buckling.
description: Run DFT variable-cell relaxations and Murnaghan EOS fits for all four systems.

title: Electronic structure calculation
action: Using the relaxed geometries, run spin-polarised DFT SCF calculations followed by NSCF band-structure calculations along the Γ→Z high-symmetry path to obtain Kohn-Sham eigenvalues, total and projected density of states, electron charge density, and total magnetisation.
description: Run spin-polarised DFT electronic structure calculations for all four systems.

title: Compile all properties into results.json
action: Post-process all DFT outputs to extract and compile the complete set of physical properties for each of the four configurations into a single JSON file. For each system compute: lattice constants a, b, c (Å); tubular diameter (Å); radial buckling (Å); symmetry number; bulk modulus along a, b, c axes (kbar, with a and b null for isolated tubes); band gap value (eV) and transition k-points (null for metallic Si-vacancy); effective mass CB and VB (m₀, VB null for metallic); carrier velocity v_z CB and VB (m/s, VB null for metallic); charge density s and p orbital averages for C and Si plus total charge (e); total magnetisation (μB).
description: Master JSON file containing all structural and electronic properties for the four SiC nanotube configurations.
output_schema: Object with four top-level keys: ISW_NT, BSW_NT, ISW_NTC, ISW_NTSi. Each key holds: lattice_constants {a, b, c} (float, Å), tubular_diameter (float, Å), radial_buckling (float, Å), symmetry_number (int), bulk_modulus {a, b, c} (float or null, kbar), band_gap {value, transition} (float or null, eV; string or null), effective_mass {CB, VB} (float or null, m₀), velocity_z {CB, VB} (float or null, m/s), charge_density {s_C, s_Si, p_C, p_Si, total} (float, e), total_magnetization (float, μB).
